phase_correlation_shift — FIT registration op

• 数据种类:image2d × image2d → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.phase_correlation_shift(image1, image2, window: 'str | None' = 'hann', whitening: 'float' = 0.5) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import filters_freq; filters_freq.phase_correlation_shift(image1, image2, window: 'str | None' = 'hann', whitening: 'float' = 0.5) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsfit.get("phase_correlation_shift"))

用法

用相位限定相关估计两幅图像对齐所需的亚像素平移。

复用 FFT 相关峰并以局部上采样 DFT 细化。符号与 phase_correlation_fft 相同：对齐 image1 到 image2 时返回 image2 位移的相反数。返回 dy、dx、峰值和峰值比；拒绝无纹理图像。
